component.name: Ferry
component.summary: Sticky notes on your desktop, in sync with your phone

description.p: Ferry puts sticky notes on your desktop and in widgets on your phone's home screen, and carries every note between them. Type it on your desktop, and it's on your phone.

ul.li: Each note floats in its own window, right where you left it, and can stay on top of everything else
Notes and checklists, in colours, with a list of every note in the tray
Version history brings back text you replaced
Export every note to Markdown and JSON at any time, and import them again
Ferry for Windows, Mac, iPhone and Android carries the same notes

description.p: An account only if you want one. Signed out, your notes stay on this computer, free and without limits. Sign in with Google, Apple, Microsoft or GitHub when you want them on your other devices too: syncing them is Ferry Pro, a subscription or a one-off purchase, with a free trial of 30 days.

screenshot.caption: Notes on the desktop, beside the list of every note
Checklists and notes, in the dark too

description.p: The AppImage opens your default browser to sign in or to buy Pro, on KDE Plasma 6 and elsewhere.
A maintenance release: signing in is reorganised for the Mac and works here as before.
The AppImage starts in sandboxes that open it themselves, such as firejail.
Ferry comes from the Snap Store too, where it starts at login and hands a second launch to the copy already running, as everywhere else.
The AppImage no longer opens a blank window on newer distributions, such as Ubuntu 26.04.
